1. Copy .env.example or set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.
2. Local emulator / simulator: http://localhost:4000
3. Android emulator: http://10.0.2.2:4000
4. Physical phone: http://<your-computer-lan-ip>:4000
